fusions.name: Stinger Shoe
fusions.desc: A quick kick that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scatter the Hive
fusions.desc: Tramples the ground around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Untiring Pace
fusions.desc: You regain 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Drover's Swarm
fusions.desc: You move 6% faster, and a swarm escorts you, stinging a nearby enemy for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds.
